info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Estimates-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Estimates API provides a streamlined method for retrieving detailed estimates associated with insurance claims. This endpoint allows users to access specific claim estimations, which is essential for assessing potential payouts and understanding claim statuses. Typical consumers include insurance adjusters, claims analysts, and customer service representatives who require real-time information about claim estimates for efficient decision-making. Use this API to enhance transparency and improve communication with claimants regarding their insurance claims.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain an estimate for claims based on the provided criteria. It helps users to assess potential claim values quickly and efficiently.
